description: Security-testing authorization policy consumed by security-verification-engine.mjs before invoking ANY external security tool (OSV-Scanner, CodeQL, Graphify) or acting on its own secret-scan/dependency-audit findings. Reuses the existing classification vocabulary this pack already applies to side effects (.claude/rules/side-effects-recovery.md) rather than inventing a second taxonomy. No external tool may bypass this policy.

classifications.PASSIVE: Local, read-only static analysis — secret scanning, dependency manifest inspection, SARIF/JSON parsing of already-produced results. Always permitted.
classifications.SAFE_ACTIVE: Execution permitted only against localhost, fixtures, containers, or another explicitly authorized environment — never a real target project's production or shared infrastructure.
classifications.INTRUSIVE: Requires an explicit approval-request (.claude/contracts/approval-request.schema.json) GRANTED before execution.
classifications.EXTERNAL_UNAUTHORIZED: Always BLOCK — sending code, dependency lists, or repository data to an external service without explicit authorization.

osv-scanner.note: osv-scanner's default `--format json` mode queries the real OSV.dev API over HTTPS to resolve vulnerability data — it is NOT a fully local/offline analysis despite being read-only. Gated on `networkAllowed` below, same as any other network-touching capability; when networkAllowed is false this tool is SKIPPED (graceful degradation, OPTIONAL — never a BLOCK) rather than silently invoked in contradiction of the policy.

codeql.note: database create/analyze against local source is fully local; downloading a query pack (codeql pack download) IS network-requiring and is never done automatically by this pack's adapter.

graphify.note: Graphify's real CLI (confirmed via `graphify --help`) exposes distinct LOCAL and NETWORK operations — classified per-operation, not as one opaque binary-wide verdict.

path.description: shortest-path query against an already-built local graph.json

explain.description: local read-only node explanation against an existing graph.json

diagnose.description: local multigraph-collapse diagnostic against an existing graph.json

clone.description: clones an arbitrary GitHub repo — real network/data-egress

add.description: fetches an arbitrary URL into the local corpus — real network/data-egress

install.description: writes graphify config/hooks into another agent's CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/settings — a persistent configuration change to this environment, never invoked automatically
